title: Page 1
content_zh:
天信集团乃台湾商界重量级集团，经营范围含括石化能源、百货零售、金融服务、海陆运输、通讯网路、社会公益……等领域，为国内老字号集团转往多角化经营成功的典范。
第三代掌门人掌信年届六十，现已交棒给第四代，他的三个儿子——
掌尚智、掌尚仁、掌尚勇。
国小毕业就陆续出国当小留生的三兄弟，在国外拿到企业管理博士后，陆续回国。
总裁一职由大儿子掌尚智接掌，年届三十的他成熟、稳重，肃穆神情常令人不寒而栗。
三年前拿到双博士学位，回国在父亲身边帮忙，不到半年的时间，已经顺利干掉老头……呃，不是，是帮父亲扛下肩头重担。一年前，父亲完全放心地把天信集团交给他，他誓言要带领天信集团再创高峰。
副总裁则由二十八岁的二儿子掌尚仁担任，外貌俊美的他，最擅长的是花言巧语和为富不仁的奸商手段。
而刚回国不到半年的三儿子掌尚勇，则是接下首席财务总监一职。
英气逼人的三兄弟，魅力无法挡，三年来，想考进天信集团的女性同胞，加总起来超过三万人，录取率屡创新低。据说，过去几十年报考的女性全部加总，尚不到一百人。
这是好现象。掌信和妻子夏水荷可乐歪了嘴，心里打着主意，想从女性员工里，挑出三个优秀的女生来当他们掌家的媳妇。
这个馊主意，早就被成为奸商……呃，聪明过人的三兄弟识破，三人联合起来，把老爸老妈送到国外去旅游半年，至少他们的耳根子可以清静半年。
现阶段，老大掌尚智一心想再创天信集团的事业高峰，哪有时间谈恋爱、娶老婆！
而老二掌尚仁满肚子的花言巧语，怎么可能只对一个女生说，不嫌太暴殄天物吗？老爸，您就别闹了吧！
老三掌尚勇没想太多，但是，被夜店的一堆辣美眉簇拥，感觉挺不错的，他可不想在夜店当大王时，被一个黄脸婆拉着耳朵，一路念回家。
所以，要他们结婚？别傻了，短期之内绝不可能！
第1章(1)
意大利．佛罗伦萨。
「伊莎贝儿，麻烦你带这对老夫妇欣赏陶艺区的作品。」一位身穿燕尾服，目光炯炯的白发老先生，以流利的意大利语，微笑交代站在他身旁显得娇小却女人韵味十足的黑发女子。
「我很乐意。」伊莎贝儿露出亲切的笑容，带领老夫妇走向艺廊，细心的为他们解说每项陶艺品的名称和其创作理念。
她本名叫保贝儿，来自台弯，在佛罗伦萨的一所艺术学院攻读硕士，她爱极了陶艺，尽管家中经济并不优渥，但她仍坚持只身来到徐志摩笔下最美丽的都市——翡冷翠，也是艺术之都佛罗伦萨。

为了筹学费、生活费，幸运的她，经同学介绍，在不上课的日子里，来这家私人艺廊担任解说员，平日节省的她，靠自己打工赚的钱，顺利完成学业。
保贝儿原本早该回国，独自拉拔她长大的母亲正等着她回去团聚，但感念艺廊老板在她求学期间对她的帮助，她答应在他找到心中合适的接替人选后，再回台湾。
眼前这对老夫妇是日本观光客，她用简单的日语夹杂英语和他们交谈，老夫妇听见熟悉的语言，格外开心。
她在这里，除了能多学习她热爱的陶艺外，也学到了许多简单的外语，而日语、韩语是她学习最多的外语。
在带领老夫妇参观陶艺区时，艺廊又走进两名客人，一位是本地人，她认得他，他是老板的好友，常担任观光客的私人翻译兼地陪，当然，他也常带客人来参观艺廊。
另一名男客人外表看起来像是亚洲人，但是他的身高……哇！她只能说他长得又高又壮活像棵大树，或者……神木。
来艺廊的亚洲客人，很少有比老板还高的。
男客人粗犷的外表，古铜肤色，看起来和艺廊格格不入，不是她以貌取人，而是以他的形貌似乎比较适合待在竞技场。她看得出来他有点烦躁，对于摆设的陶艺品只淡淡一瞥，不像其它客人驻足欣赏。
「哇，那个客人好高壮。」
日本老婆婆的声音把她游离的心神拉回现实，她窘地微微一笑，她从来没在解说当下失神，那样对客人很不礼貌，今天她却因为观看一个「很壮」的男人看到发愣，好糗！
「看起来像韩国人。」老先生和老婆婆低声交谈，对那位壮汉颇感好奇。
「日本人。」老婆婆露出骄傲神情，似乎以和他同个国家为荣。
「新加坡人。」
「日本人。」
老夫妇猜测之际，壮汉已来到他们身边，坚持他是同胞的老婆婆，对他微笑，并用日语和他打招呼。
「你好。」
「你好。」壮汉脸上没有太多表情，以生涩的日语响应。
老婆婆像押对宝一般，兴奋地拉着他的手，说了一长串的日语；壮汉皱起眉头，一脸困惑地望向身后，随行的翻译人员去上厕所还没回来，他求救的目光落在她身上。
「请问你是日本人吗？」保贝儿看出他的困惑，用英文询问他。
「我不是。」壮汉终于了解老婆婆干啥拉着他热切的说个不停。

听得懂英文的老先生，赶紧拉开老伴，向她解释壮汉不是日本人，老婆婆旋即放手频频向他鞠躬道歉。
「没关系，我不介意。」
老婆婆道完歉后，抓着老先生的手，要他问壮汉是哪里人，老先生对妻子打破砂锅问到底的行为小小皱眉，要她别打扰他人，眼见壮汉已走到另一头，老婆婆只好作罢。
但兜了一圈后，一行人又碰头了。
保贝儿和地陪点头打招呼，地陪蓦地想起什么，咧着笑告诉她，「Isabella，这位先生是来自你的故乡台湾哦。」
「真的吗？」
地陪先生转身告诉身后的壮汉同样的话，壮汉立即伸手，露出友善的笑容打招呼，「你好。」
保贝儿正要伸手，老婆婆快她一步握住壮汉的手，拉拉杂杂的又说了一长串日语，大意是说他真的很像日本人，又说她某个亲戚的儿子也像他这么高大又英俊。
基于对方是个老婆婆，壮汉虽然听不懂，仍是礼貌性的点头，老先生在一旁尴尬笑着，解释他老婆个性就是如此，请大家多多包涵。
保贝儿忍不住窃笑，老婆婆真的好可爱，怎么会对一个不认识、还听不懂她说的语言的人，劈哩啦说一长串，尽管老先生插话告诉她他是台湾人，她还是一直强调他真的很像日本人，还关心的问壮汉结婚了没、有没有女朋友？
时间过了十分钟。
每个人脸上的笑都消失，唯有老婆婆还一脸笑呵呵，滔滔不绝讲个不停。她试图制止过老婆婆五次之多，但老婆婆只是笑笑的拍拍她的手，继续说她的；老先生也劝阻多次，奈何拉不开她，他气得自己去看陶艺品，不再理她。
连地陪先生也试图想拉开老婆婆，但基于她是客人，他不能太粗鲁，终究徒劳无功。
「Isabella，想想办法。」见自己带来的客人已摆出臭脸，地陪无奈地向她求救。
「老婆婆，这位先生要离开了……」保贝儿好言相劝，但老婆婆仍无动于衷。
「够了，停止！放开你的手。」壮汉低声喝止，但老婆婆根本听不懂，以为他害羞，讲得更起劲。
content_en:
Tianxin Group is a heavyweight group in Taiwan's business community. Its business scope includes petrochemical energy, department store retail, financial services, land and sea transportation, communication networks, social welfare... and other fields. It is a successful example of domestic time-honored groups turning to diversified operations.
The third-generation head of the family, who is now sixty years old, has handed over the reins to the fourth generation, his three sons——
The palm promotes wisdom, the palm promotes benevolence, and the palm promotes courage.
The three brothers, who went abroad to study as primary school students after graduating from elementary school, received postdocs in business management abroad and returned to China one after another.
The position of CEO was taken over by the eldest son Zhang Shangzhi. He is mature and steady in his thirties, and his solemn expression is often chilling.
I got a double doctorate three years ago and returned to China to help my father. In less than half a year, I had successfully killed the old man... Well, no, I was helping my father carry the heavy burden on his shoulders. A year ago, his father handed Tianxin Group over to him with complete confidence, and he vowed to lead Tianxin Group to new heights.
The vice president is held by the 28-year-old second son Zhang Shangren. He is handsome in appearance and is best at smooth talk and ruthless businessmanship to get rich.
The third son, Zhang Shangyong, who had just returned to China less than half a year ago, took over the post of chief financial director.
The three heroic brothers are irresistibly charming. In the past three years, the total number of female compatriots who want to be admitted to Tianxin Group has exceeded 30,000, and the admission rate has hit new lows. It is said that the total number of women who have applied for the exam in the past few decades is less than 100.
This is a good sign. Zhang Xin and his wife Xia Shuihe Cola twisted their mouths and made up their mind to select three outstanding girls from among the female employees to be the wives of their boss.
This bad idea has long been seen through by the three brothers who became profiteers... well, they were extremely smart. The three of them joined forces and sent their parents to travel abroad for half a year. At least their ears would be quiet for half a year.
At this stage, the boss, Shang Zhi, is so focused on reaching the peak of Tianxin Group’s career that he has no time to fall in love or marry a wife!
And how could the second-in-command Shangren, who was full of sweet words, say it to just one girl, without it being too wasteful? Dad, please stop making trouble!
The third child, Shang Yong, didn't think too much, but it felt good to be surrounded by a bunch of hot beauties in the nightclub. He didn't want to be pulled by the ear by a yellow-faced woman who talked about her all the way home when he was the king of the nightclub.
So, you want them to get married? Don't be stupid, it will never be possible in the short term!
Chapter 1(1)
Italy. Florence.
"Isabel, please show this old couple the works in the pottery area." A white-haired old man in a tuxedo with piercing eyes spoke in fluent Italian with a smile to the petite but feminine black-haired woman standing next to him.
"I'm very happy." Isabel showed a friendly smile, led the old couple to the art gallery, and carefully explained to them the name of each pottery product and its creation concept.
Her real name is Bao Beier. She comes from Taiwan and is studying for a master's degree at an art academy in Florence. She loves pottery so much that even though her family is not financially well-off, she still insists on coming alone to Florence, the most beautiful city in Xu Zhimo's works - Florence, which is also the capital of art.
In order to raise tuition and living expenses, she was lucky enough to be introduced by her classmates and work as a commentator in this private art gallery on days when she was not in class. She saved money on weekdays and relied on the money she earned from her part-time job to successfully complete her studies.
Bao Beier should have returned to China long ago. Her mother, who raised her alone, was waiting for her to go back and reunite. However, she was grateful to the gallery owner for helping her during her studies. She promised to return to Taiwan after he found a suitable successor in his mind.
The old couple in front of her were Japanese tourists. She talked to them in simple Japanese mixed with English. The old couple were particularly happy to hear the familiar language.
Here, in addition to learning more about her passion for pottery, she also learned many simple foreign languages, among which Japanese and Korean were the foreign languages ​​she learned the most.language.
While taking the old couple to visit the ceramics area, two more guests walked into the art gallery. One was a local and she recognized him. He was a good friend of the boss and often served as a personal translator and escort for tourists. Of course, he also often brought guests to visit the art gallery.
Another male guest looks Asian, but his height... wow! She could only say that he was as tall and strong as a big tree, or... a sacred tree.
There are very few Asian customers who come to the gallery who are taller than the boss.
The male guest's rugged appearance and bronze complexion seemed incompatible with the art gallery. It was not that she judged people by their appearance, but that his appearance seemed more suitable for staying in the arena. She could see that he was a little irritable, and he only glanced at the pottery on display, unlike other guests who stopped to admire it.
"Wow, that guest is so tall and strong."
The voice of the old Japanese woman brought her wandering mind back to reality. She smiled in embarrassment. She had never explained that she was distracted at the moment. It was very rude to the guests. But today she was stunned because she was watching a "very strong" man. How embarrassing!
"Looks like a Korean." The old man and the old woman whispered, curious about the strong man.
"Japanese." The old woman looked proud, as if she was proud to be from the same country as him.
"Singaporean."
"Japanese."
While the old couple was guessing, the strong man had already come to them. The old woman insisted that he was a compatriot, smiled at him, and greeted him in Japanese.
"Hello."
"Hello." The strong man didn't have much expression on his face and responded in jerky Japanese.
The old woman held his hand excitedly as if betting on something, and spoke a long string of Japanese words; the strong man frowned and looked behind him in confusion. The accompanying translator had not returned from going to the toilet, and his eyes for help fell on her.
"Are you Japanese?" Bao Beier saw his confusion and asked him in English.
"I'm not." The strong man finally understood what the old woman was doing and kept him talking eagerly.
The old man who understood English quickly pulled away from his wife and explained to her that the strong man was not Japanese. The old woman immediately let go and bowed to him frequently to apologize.
"It's okay, I don't mind."
After the old woman apologized, she grabbed the old man's hand and asked him to ask the strong man where he was from. The old man frowned slightly at his wife's behavior of breaking the casserole and asked her not to disturb others. Seeing that the strong man had walked to the other side, the old woman had no choice but to give up.
But after going around for a while, the group met again.
Bao Beier nodded and said hello to the escort. The escort suddenly remembered something and told her with a grin, "Isabella, this gentleman is from your hometown of Taiwan."
"Really?"
The local escort turned around and told the strong man behind him the same thing. The strong man immediately stretched out his hand and said hello with a friendly smile, "Hello."
Just as Bao Beier was about to reach out, the old woman stepped ahead of her and took the strong man's hand. She said a long string of Japanese in a garbled way, to the effect that he really looked like a Japanese, and that the son of one of her relatives was as tall and handsome as him.
Because the other party was an old woman, although the strong man didn't understand, he still nodded politely. The old man smiled awkwardly and explained that his wife's personality was like this, so please bear with me.
Bao Beier couldn't help but snicker. The old lady was really cute. How could she say a long list of words to someone who didn't know her and couldn't understand the language she spoke? Even though the old man interrupted and told her that he was Taiwanese, she kept emphasizing that he really looked like a Japanese. She also asked the strong man with concern if he was married or if he had a girlfriend?
Ten minutes passed.
The smiles disappeared from everyone's faces, except for the old lady who still smiled and kept talking. She tried to stop the old lady five times, but the old lady just patted her hand with a smile and continued to talk about her. The old man also tried to dissuade her many times, but he couldn't pull her away. He was so angry that he went to see the pottery by himself.Ignore her.
Even the local escort tried to pull the old woman away, but since she was a guest, he couldn't be too rude, and it was all in vain.
"Isabella, think of a way." Seeing that the guest she brought had a bad look on her face, the hostess helplessly asked her for help.
"Old lady, this gentleman is leaving..." Bao Beier tried to persuade her, but the old lady remained indifferent.
"That's enough, stop! Let go of your hand." The strong man shouted in a low voice, but the old woman couldn't understand her at all and thought he was shy and spoke more energetically.
